operation.summary: Run a fixed supported action on this agent's enrolled device

body.name: action
body.description: Use this device's advertised actions (built-in: status, relay_on, relay_off, dhcp_leases; packs list theirs in GET /v1/lan/devices adapters)

body.name: channel
body.description: Shelly relay channel 0..3; must be advertised by device; default 0

body.name: params
body.description: Device-pack action parameters, e.g. {"url":"https://example.com/chime.mp3"} for play, {"level":30} for volume_set or {"muted":true} for mute_set. They may also be sent beside device and action ({"level":30}); the same name in both places must agree. Each action's parameters (name, type, required, bounds) are listed in GET /v1/lan/devices devices[].actions[].params

operation.returns: device, action, availability=online, checked_at, result; failures do not prove offline. Its own rate limit: 30 actions a minute per agent, separate from captures. Camera snapshots/move use existing lan_camera endpoints.
